Total no. of money disbursed from 1982 - 1986 

For Bank A = 18 + 23 + 45 + 30 + 70 = 186 (in ₹ crore) 

For Bank B = 27 + 33 + 18 + 41 + 37 = 156 (in ₹ crore) 

For Bank C = 29 + 28 + 22 + 17 + 11 = 107 (in ₹ crore) 

For Bank D = 31 + 16 + 28 + 32 + 43 = 150 (in ₹ crore)

**∴ The disbursement of loans continuously decreases over the years for bank C.**
